skills.name: Prodigium
lines: This skill changes based of whether this is used in Another Force
* [Normal] Target a single party member, main or reserve. Revive them, grant Type attack +30% (1 move), and restore 30 MP to them.
** 1 HP and 30 MP > 30% max HP and 40 MP > 60% max HP and 50 MP based on number of Blessing stacked.
*[Another Force] Grants all party members Type attack +20% (1 move).
** Type Attack 20% > 30% > 40% based on number of orbs
*[United] Effect is strengthened based on the amount of accumulated Blessing stacks.
** Blessings orbs are consumed on skill use.
